description: Abstract class SandboxManagerBase manages stage directories for Drupal, handling creation, claiming, requiring packages, applying changes, and destruction with event dispatching and ownership validation.

classes.name: Drupal\package_manager\SandboxManagerBase
classes.description: Abstract class managing stage directories for Drupal, handling creation, claiming, requiring packages, applying changes, and destruction with event dispatching and ownership validation.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the stage type used for logic specific to certain stages, must be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the stage directory can be created (not locked).

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves a piece of metadata associated with the stage, requires ownership.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Stores arbitrary metadata for the stage, requires ownership.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and claims a new stage directory, copying active code base.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Adds or updates packages in the stage, then optionally updates dependencies.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies staged changes to the active directory, handling errors and marking state.

methods.name: postApply
methods.description: Performs post-apply tasks like cache clearing and container rebuilding.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the stage directory, queues cleanup if needed, and stores destroy info.

methods.name: isDirectWrite
methods.description: Checks if active directory is modified directly, based on global settings and attribute.

methods.name: sandboxDirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if the sandbox directory exists.

methods.name: getSandboxDirectory
methods.description: Returns path of the directory where changes are staged.

methods.name: getStagingRoot
methods.description: Returns path where stage directories are created, cached in temp store.

methods.name: isApplying
methods.description: Checks if staged changes are currently being applied, within an hour window.

methods.name: getFailureMarkerMessage
methods.description: Provides message indicating failure in applying staged changes.

methods.name: validateRequirements
methods.description: Validates package names against regex patterns for composer requirements.

methods.name: storeDestroyInfo
methods.description: Stores info about stage destruction, including reason message.

methods.name: claim
methods.description: Claims ownership of the stage with a unique ID, verifying lock matches.

methods.name: checkOwnership
methods.description: Validates current ownership of the stage before operations.
